entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi, Isaac. I'm a bit confused. I have this helmet I bought... a while ago, I think? I need to return it, but I find the website so overwhelming. I just don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. No problem at all. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything. It's the color. I got it and I just realized it's not very visible, you know? For safety on the road. The box is still unopened, it's just been sitting there. I get so flustered with these policies. Can't you just help me?

Of course, that's what I'm here for. I understand completely. So it's a color preference, and the item is still in its original packaging. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... one moment.
Okay, I see the order here for the Pro-Frame helmet. It looks like it was delivered 75 days ago. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you.

Alright, I have good news. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. Since you're at day 75 and the box unopened, you are perfectly within the timeframe to return it for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you, that's such a relief.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label as we speak. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's so much easier than I thought. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
It's my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
No, that was it. You've been great. Thanks again.
You're most welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
